items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: 2:00 o'clock, we went out to Rudy Van Gelder's and made the first Cannonball date.

ctx.x: He just heard it the one time?

Just heard it. Man, he was such a fantastic musician. That's what he was, a music teacher. And he came up there, he played, "Bohemia After Dark," I said, "Well, who wrote it, you or Oscar?" And Oscar looked at him and said, "Boy, you are fantastic." So that was the beginning of Cannonball. So the next day he said, "Well, I'm living with my aunt and we have to get back, but I have no money, you know." So I said, "Tomorrow at 2:00 o'clock you have a record date." He said, "A record date?" I said, "That's right." So…
